God has stood on a brick for thousands of years, and never sat down. Stay till the end, the reason will melt your heart.
As the story goes, Pundalik served his old parents day and night, washing their feet, feeding them by hand. But one night, Krishna Himself knocked at his door.
Pundalik was pressing his father's feet. He didn't stop. He threw out a brick and said, stand on this and wait. Wait, he made God wait?

Krishna smiled, put His hands on His hips, and stood on that brick. He never left. That's why Vitthal still stands on a brick in Pandharpur. Serving your parents is worship. Comment Vitthal, and send this to someone who cares for their parents.
